finding.comment: the consumer slurps the JSONL into an array before any(.[]; …), so the check matches the documented one-object-per-line input format

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/scan.sh
+++ b/scripts/scan.sh
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
 # findings were collected as JSONL (one object per line):
 #   jq -c '.[]' <<<"$batch" >>"$events_jsonl"
+if ! jq -s -e 'any(.[]; .level == "error")' <"$events_jsonl" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "at least one error finding" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
